display.title: Capstone: Lucifer
display.subtitle: The combat gate of Tier 3 to Tier 4
description: Lucifer is the combat capstone. He is the final boss of the Tier 3
boss-rush, and he drops a unique Lucifer's Token.
Two combat doors lead through him:
- Complete the full Tier 3 boss-rush (he is the last name on the list).
- Or explore/bank your way up, then fight him and submit his token.
§7The peaceful lanes (Engineering, Magic) skip Lucifer entirely - banking
§72000 tokens reaches Tier 4 with no fight. This is the one deliberate
§7pinch-point where a combat-averse player must choose a non-combat lane.
§cBUILD NOTE: Lucifer's entity id + token item are not yet finalized.
§cThis quest's kill task uses a placeholder - see the report.
